name: PDF RAG (API) - Chat
description: Answer questions from the ingested PDFs with Gemini, citing page numbers.
rationale: One retrieval and one Gemini call per question keeps cost low; source and page travel with each passage so answers can cite them.
assumptions: Run the ingest flow first; both flows must use the same url and collection_name.
Create Langflow global variables MISTRAL_API_KEY, QDRANT_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY.
Left out on purpose: sparse or hybrid search, reranker, relevance gate and query router; search is dense only.
Left out on purpose: section summaries, so questions about the whole document only see the top 6 passages.
